description: This file defines the AnnouncementTransformer class in PHP, which extends AbstractTransformer. It transforms Announcement model data into a format suitable for other uses, providing methods to retrieve announcement type and related actions.

classes.name: AnnouncementTransformer
classes.description: A transformer class that converts Announcement model data into structured representations, including announcement type and action URLs.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Retrieves the localized type description of the announcement based on its type property.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Generates and returns a list of action URLs (edit, translate, delete) for the announcement if the user has permissions.
